VISTA.EnableStripsHint: When enabled, this scene uses abstract strips instead of a battle map.
VISTA.StripCountHint: How many horizontal strips to divide the scene into (1 to 4).
VISTA.StripLabelsHint: Optional labels for each strip, e.g. 'Bar, Common Room, Stage'.
VISTA.PadLeftHint: Offset strip content from the left.
VISTA.PadRightHint: Offset strip content from the right.
VISTA.DebugModeHint: Enable debug logging to the console for troubleshooting.
VISTA.LineColorHint: Color of the horizontal lines between strips.
VISTA.LineThicknessHint: Thickness of the horizontal lines between strips (in pixels).
VISTA.LineOpacityHint: Opacity of the horizontal lines between strips (0.0 = transparent, 1.0 = opaque).
VISTA.DefaultPadLeftHint: Default horizontal offset from the left for new scenes (pixels).
VISTA.DefaultPadRightHint: Default horizontal offset from the right for new scenes (pixels).
VISTA.DefaultStripLinesVisibleHint: Whether strip separator lines are visible by default for new scenes.
VISTA.AddStripHint: Add one strip to the current scene (max 4).
VISTA.RemoveStripHint: Remove one strip from the current scene (min 1).
VISTA.ToggleStripLinesHint: Toggle visibility of the strip separator lines for the current scene.
